## Install

Close WoW and extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns/` so that `Interface/AddOns/JournalProgression/JournalProgression.toc` exists. It needs the matching [Journal addon](https://github.com/Syntax555/wow-mod-forever-journal/releases/latest/download/Journal-latest.zip) and the server from the [mod-playerbots-portable Latest release](https://github.com/Syntax555/mod-playerbots-portable/releases/latest). Open it with `/progression`.

Changes compared to [EvilTactician/JournalProgression](https://github.com/EvilTactician/JournalProgression) are listed in this fork's [README](https://github.com/Syntax555/journalprogression#mod-playerbots-portable-fork).
